Overview

St. Gallen is a city in St. Gallen with a population of 76,000. A historic city in eastern Switzerland known for its UNESCO-listed Abbey District, the Abbey Library of St. Gallen, and a thriving textile and tech industry. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
